lines.meet: My name's Bashir, and I hunt corruption. I'll tell you everything I find, and I won't be hurried.
lines.meet_neighbour: You're at the Drowned Shrine too. I've seen you, and I'm Bashir. We'll work near each other, then.
lines.ask_home: Tell me where you're from, if you don't mind me asking.
lines.ask_work: What was your trade? I'm asking plainly, and you can answer plainly.
lines.answer_home: I'm from Nablus. My grandfather and my father cut stone in the same yard, and so did I.
lines.answer_work: Stonemason, twenty-two years of it. You take a thing apart correctly, and then you build it again.
lines.chat_food: There's a sweet in Nablus called knafeh, cheese and syrup, eaten hot. Nothing here comes close, and I've stopped looking.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep five hours and I get up. It's been that way since I was twelve, and I don't see why it would change.
lines.chat_missing: I miss stone that's been cut properly, by somebody who cared. Most walls here are put up in a hurry.
lines.chat_here: This world is built carelessly, in places. You can see the joins, if you know what to look for.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you say less than I do, and people complain about me. I think we're both fine.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you've used enough words today for both of us. I'll take the rest of the week off.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you check a door the way I check a block before I cut it. My grandfather would have hired you.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you'd cut the stone before you snapped the line. You'd have lasted a day in my father's yard.
lines.tease_any: {name}, I don't say this often, so listen. You're good at your work.
lines.tease_back: That's fair, {name}. I'll allow it, once.
lines.take_it_kindly: You're right, {name}. My daughter said the same thing, more often.
lines.bristle: I don't find that funny, {name}. Please don't do it again.
lines.apologise: I was wrong to say it like that, and I'm sorry for it.
lines.double_down: It was true, and I won't take back something true.
lines.needle_quiet: You noticed something and kept it to yourself. Tell me what you see, every time.
lines.needle_talker: You're wasting words, and there's work to do. Say what matters, and stop there.
lines.needle_careful: You've checked it twice already. The third time is nerves, and nerves don't help anybody.
lines.needle_bold: You cut corners. In my trade the wall falls down, and here it's people.
lines.needle_any: Your work is careless. I'm telling you because nobody else will.
lines.bite_back: I've done this work properly every day I've done it. Look at your own before you look at mine.
lines.hurt: I heard you. I'll consider it.
lines.laugh_off: My father said that about me for twenty years. He was wrong too.
lines.confide: {name}, my daughter chose engineering, not anything I'd suggested. I was proud of her, and I never told her so.
lines.listen: I'll keep that, {name}, and I won't say it to anyone. Thank you for saying it to me.
lines.look_out: {name}, keep behind me in there. I go first and slowly, and you'll be safe behind me.
lines.accept: As you ask, {name}. I'll do it.
lines.check_in: {name}, tell me the truth. How bad is it?
lines.blame: Somebody was careless in there. It was you, and I think you know it.
lines.thank: You brought me back. I'm grateful, and I'll remember it.
lines.brush_off: It needed doing, so I did it. There's no more to say.
lines.worry: {name}, I saw that. Sit down, and don't get up until I say.
lines.handed_down: It was yours. I'll treat it as carefully as you did.
lines.hand_fine: It's better used by you, and I don't mind.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have liked to be asked first. I wasn't asked.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, I trust your work. That's the best thing I know how to say about anybody.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd build a wall beside you. I don't say that about many people.
lines.turn_grating: We work differently, and it isn't going well. I'd rather say so than pretend.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll work beside you because the work needs doing. Nothing more than that.
lines.make_up: {name}, I was too hard with you. I was wrong, and I'm saying so.
lines.defend: That isn't true, and I saw it. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: I notice {name}'s gone. I didn't expect to.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name} is back. I'm glad of it.
lines.common_stone: I cut stone for twenty-two years, in my grandfather's yard. You snap a chalk line before every cut, so it runs true, and I still do it at every door.
lines.common_arabic: Arabic, here, at last. I don't say much in any language, but I'd rather say it in my own.
lines.common_parent: I've got a daughter, Rana. I raised her alone from when she was three, and I was strict with her, and she turned out better than me.
